data.selectionPolicy: distance-ranked candidates only; no automatic representativeness selection
data.stationContinuity: observations remain grouped by station; no cross-station splice
data.intervalSemantics: station instants; precipitationLastHourMm is the reported preceding-hour accumulation ending at observation time
data.attribution: Station observations from NOAA National Weather Service (https://www.weather.gov/); quality flags from MADIS.
